result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks with significant obstructions from utility poles, particularly on the left side. The environment lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic calming, while parked cars create sightline issues.

hazards.name: Utility poles on sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the center of the narrow left-side sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the street or squeeze past.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures the view of pedestrians, especially children, for oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add zebra-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, accessible path of travel.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous concrete sidewalk that is currently compromised by a large area of missing pavement, creating a significant trip hazard. While a traffic signal is present, there are no visible crosswalk markings or pedestrian-specific signals, and the walkway lacks a buffer from the adjacent roadway.

hazards.name: Damaged Sidewalk
hazards.description: A large rectangular section of the sidewalk is missing or unpaved, creating a deep depression and significant trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Directly in front of the tan-colored building facade on the left side of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible at this signalized intersection, reducing pedestrian visibility and safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area adjacent to the traffic light pole on the right.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Fill and pave the missing section of the sidewalk to provide a level, continuous walking surface for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time and improve safety.

result.summary: The image shows a standard urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and signalized control. However, the environment lacks modern safety enhancements like curb extensions, and existing pavement markings are significantly faded.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and middle ground of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white truck parked close to the intersection corner limits visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the faded crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic paint to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to the roadway, obstructed by a utility pole. hazards.description: The intersection of 50th and Brown St lacks visible crosswalk markings, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the street.
